raw_evidence_sections.text: FAQ – Bachelor courses in Germany When you opt for a full-time bachelor degree , studying is your "main job". You will attend lectures every day, write assignments or work on group projects with fellow students and prepare for exams. You dedicate yourself fully to your Bachelor's program. The workload of a full-time bachelor course is equivalent to a full-time job. You will receive your lecture timetable at the start of your bachelor studies and attend the respective courses provided for in your Bachelor's degree program. The full-time Bachelor degree in English in Germany at ISM is characterized by a strong international focus . In addition to basic business knowledge , you can also deepen or learn optional foreign languages and can gain a lot of practical experience through internships and practical projects with global companies. The Bachelor's degree curricula includes many weeks of internships in which you gain practical, on the job experience. The advantage of this is that internships are often paid and you earn money alongside your full-time bachelor studies. In the case of ISM, your studies also always include a semester spent abroad at one of the many partner universities of the ISM. Another opportunity with our full-time Bachelor's program is that you can add an additional semester (Global Track) to your Bachelor of science in Germany and complete it at one of our international partner universities. In the end, you will have collected 210 ECTS points instead of 180 and will score points in your future job applications with even more international experience. If you opt for English bachelor programs in Germany , this will help you improve your language skills and develop intercultural skills by working alongside other foreign students during your Bachelor of Sc

raw_evidence_sections.text: For the bachelor degree programs in English in Germany at ISM, you will need a valid higher education entrance qualification such as a general higher education entrance qualification, an entrance qualification for universities of applied sciences or a relevant professional qualification. You do NOT have to fulfill an NC (Numerus Clausus) or meet certain GPA criteria! Recommended application period beforehand : At least 1 month in advance if your country of origin is in the EU/EEA and you do not need a visa. Ca. 4 months - up to one year year before your start semester, if you come from a non-EU country and need a study visa. Please get informed from your country's German consulate how long the visa application process is currently taking, as this varies very much between countries. Deadlines for application It is also important to note the deadlines for the respective semester for a full-time Bachelor's degree. There is an application deadline for candidates who need a study visa for Germany : 15th of July for the fall term and 15th of December for the spring term.

raw_evidence_sections.text: The International School of Management (ISM) is a state-recognized private university with 35 years of educational experience. All study programs bear the seal of quality of the prestigious international AACSB accreditation , FIBAA and the German Accreditation Council. This makes the ISM one of the best ranked business schools in Germany that ranks among the 6% of business schools worldwide. With seven campuses in all major cities such as Munich, Frankfurt am Main, Berlin, Cologne, Dortmund, Hamburg and Stuttgart, ISM is a well established international University of Applied Sciences focused on practice-oriented management education. The studies are taught by lecturers who are experts and practitioners in their industry and who teach based on real-life business scenarios and have internationality aspects backing up their teaching. A semester abroad and many weeks of internship and case studies with international activing companies are an integral part of your Master degree studies. Individualized support , in particular for international students is also a part of ISM's mission: we know that successful learning also requires interaction between students as well as academic and organizational support and we offer these as integral part of your Master study journey. We assist students from ca. 84 countries, helping them take the next steps in their successful academic journey.

raw_evidence_sections.text: The Master International Management program Curriculum and courses With a Master in International Management at ISM in Germany you can build specifically on your previous international business knowledge, further develop your management and organisational skills and kick-start a leading position in business . In this full-time postgraduate international management program, general management theory, analytics & practice are closely interlinked. In addition to the practice-oriented business management content, you can also choose your own individual focus: weather accounting and finance, marketing or operations management - all the wide range of skills you need as a future organisation manager will be taught in this multi-disciplinary management programme. The integrated practical, real-life case-studies, study excursions and internships at companies offer you extensive opportunities to gain hands-on experience, practice problem-solving, connect with companies and prove yourself in various areas. This massively increases your employability after graduating the Master's in International Management. Basic know-how: Global Business Management, Strategic Management, Leadership Skills. Specific expertise: Controlling & Finance; International Marketing; Operations Management; Managing Consulting Projects.

raw_evidence_sections.text: FAQ – MBA degree programs Germany is a popular destination for international MBA students, and German universities are often considered to be a top destination country for MBA studies. Pursuing an MBA in Germany is an excellent opportunity for graduates looking to take their careers to the next level and getting practical experience. Germany is a very strong economy and has a good reputation for innovation, being home to cutting-edge industries, such as technology and engineering. As the largest economy in the European Union and the fourth largest in the world, Germany is a great place to study business administration and gain valuable managerial knowledge and experience. Additionally, Germany is home to some of the world's most prestigious business schools and top universities, both public and private, offering MBA programs that are internationally recognized and respected. Another benefit of studying an MBA in Germany is the diverse range of program options available. Our ISM MBA programs in Germany are taught only in English and not in German language, making it accessible to international students. This also allows students to develop their language skills and immerse themselves in a new culture.
